findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：Credo 所有產品的製造與組裝外包給第三方，主要在亞洲；研發點含美、加、中國大陸、台灣、香港；地緣不穩與關稅被列為供應鏈與需求的不確定來源（搜尋摘要轉述，未讀全文）
findings.source: SEC EDGAR, Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd Form 10-K FY2026 (period ended 2026-05-02)
findings.excerpt: Credo outsources all product fabrication and assembly to third parties, mostly in Asia.

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：除 BizLink 的部分 AEC 製造協議外，Credo 與 TSMC 及其他第三方代工／供應商均無長期供貨合約
findings.excerpt: Except for our agreement with BizLink for the manufacture of certain AEC products, we do not maintain long-term supply contracts with TSMC or generally with any of our third-party contract manufacturers or other suppliers.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱 TSMC、BizLink 等均未提供產能的合約保證；更換現有代工或組裝商估計需約 9–12 個月、成本上升且客戶須重新認證（搜尋摘要轉述）
findings.excerpt: None of TSMC, BizLink or our third-party manufacturers or other suppliers have provided contractual assurances to us that adequate capacity will be available to us to meet our anticipated future demand for our solutions.

findings.claim: 第三方分析稱 Credo 為無廠半導體，全部半導體產品依賴台灣 TSMC 代工，並標示兩岸緊張為中斷風險（二手來源，需對 10-K 全文交叉驗證）
findings.source: dcf-analysis.com, Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (CRDO): PESTLE Analysis [Apr-2026 Updated]
findings.excerpt: relies on TSMC in Taiwan as the foundry for all of its semiconductor products

findings.claim: 產業層面：台灣廠商在先進封裝（CoWoS/InFO）占比高，各來源數字不一（67%／85% vs 28% ATP），屬產業集中度背景，非 CRDO 專屬揭露
findings.source: Evertiq, Global semiconductor supply chain remains concentrated, exposing bottlenecks

geo_supply_chain.note: AEC 線纜組裝的實際地理位置（BizLink 等廠址）本軸未查到；dcf-analysis 日期為頁面標示的更新月份推定；excerpt 為搜尋工具摘要文字，非頁面全文；第三方客戶集中度與大中華營收占比數字未納入（來源為二手）。
